title: GTA 6's city is from 1997: 29 years of Vice City
youtube_title: GTA 6's city is from 1997: 29 years of Vice City
youtube_description:
GTA 6's city is from 1997. Vice City first appeared in the first Grand Theft Auto (1997), seen from above, as one of its three cities with Liberty City and San Andreas. GTA Vice City took it 3D on PS2 in October 2002 with a story set in 1986, 40 years before GTA 6 comes out. Vice City Stories (PSP, 2006) rewound to 1984. Now GTA 6 brings Vice City back.

1997 to 2026 is 29 years of Vice City, counted by release year. 1986 and 1984 are the in-game years the stories are set in, labeled IN-GAME YEAR on screen. 40 years is our own math (2026 minus 1986). No exact 1997 release day is claimed; sources disagree on it.

Which Vice City was best? Comment the year: 1997, 2002, 2006 or 2026.

GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Sources:
- Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI (launch date, platforms, Vice City, USA): https://www.rockstargames.com/VI (read October 29, 2026)
- Rockstar Games, Only in Leonida (quote: "We're a long way from the '80s, but Vice City is still the sun and fun capital of America."): https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/only-in-leonida (read October 29, 2026)
- Take-Two press release, December 6, 2012 (GTA Vice City first released October 2002 on PS2, built on GTA III's open world): https://ir.take2games.com/static-files/06ef640d-9baa-4e31-9d0c-fa28d63be501
- Take-Two press release, "Rockstar Games Ships Grand Theft Auto: Vice City for PlayStation 2" (October 29, 2002): https://ir.take2games.com/news-releases/news-release-details/rockstar-games-ships-grand-theft-auto-vice-city-playstation-r-2
- Take-Two press releases, Vice City Stories on PSP (October 31, 2006) and PS2 (March 2007): https://ir.take2games.com/static-files/43fadba7-2412-4215-a298-0266010c4f66 and https://ir.take2games.com/static-files/744c1b53-72cc-4587-8f90-4abb644a230d
- Secondary (Wikipedia, used as pointers): the first Grand Theft Auto, 1997, top-down, three cities, made by DMA Design and published by BMG Interactive: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grand_Theft_Auto_(video_game) ; GTA Vice City story set in 1986: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grand_Theft_Auto:_Vice_City ; Vice City Stories set in 1984: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grand_Theft_Auto:_Vice_City_Stories

Years are by release year, or by in-game year where the video labels them so.
